preconditions.expression: len(time_str) == 5 and time_str[2] == ':' and time_str[:2].isdigit() and time_str[3:].isdigit()
preconditions.description: The input string must be in HH:MM format with exactly 5 characters, where HH and MM are digits.
The input time must represent a valid time in 24-hour format.

postconditions.description: The function returns a non-negative integer representing the minutes until the next bus.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if (int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) + 5) % 900 == 0 else return_value == 900 - ((int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) + 5) % 900) if (int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) + 5) % 900 != 0 and int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) < 1440 else return_value == 1440 - (int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) + 5) if int(time_str[:2]) * 60 + int(time_str[3:]) >= 1440 else False
postconditions.description: If the current time plus 5 minutes is before 00:00, the return value is the minutes until the next bus (0 if already at a bus time). If the current time plus 5 minutes is after 00:00, the return value is the minutes until midnight (00:00).
